annotations.title: List TikTok Smart+ campaigns or ad groups

description: Read the Smart+ campaigns on a TikTok advertiser, or with level "adgroup" its Smart+ ad groups, filtered by campaignIds, adGroupIds, name, statuses, and modifiedAfter / createdAfter / createdBefore (UTC). TikTok’s reads LAG its writes, so something created seconds ago can be missing here and still exist — the reply says so rather than reporting an empty account.

adGroupIds.description: adgroup level: these ad groups (up to 100)

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

campaignIds.description: adgroup level: only ad groups in these campaigns (up to 100)

createdAfter.description: adgroup level: created after this UTC time

createdBefore.description: adgroup level: created before this UTC time

limit.description: page size, default 20 (campaigns up to 1000, ad groups up to 100)

modifiedAfter.description: adgroup level: changed after this UTC time, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"

page.description: page number, from 1; the reply says when there are more

name: list_tiktok_smart_campaigns
title: List TikTok Smart+ campaigns or ad groups
